Visible named cast: 왕먀오. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork.
